summary: General Schiess has been sworn in as the U.S. Space Force’s new Chief of Space Operations, taking command as the service explores exporting launch management lessons to foreign partners and the Pentagon unveils a new "Secure Space Network." In civil and commercial space developments, NASA selected Blue Origin to establish a Mars communications network, China’s commercial space sector moves toward public stock offerings, and European launch providers PLD Space and HyImpulse closed major funding extension rounds. In deep space exploration, the joint BepiColombo mission has begun its arrival sequence at Mercury following an eight-year transit. On the scientific front, NASA's Hubble Space Telescope captured detailed imagery of a cosmic superbubble, while preliminary planetary research reveals asteroid Bennu’s surface is 50 times weaker than ground coffee and offers fresh insights into how the early sun formed. Looking ahead, observers should watch for NASA’s scheduled coverage of the upcoming Progress 96 spacecraft launch and docking.
